# @weight 1

busybox's patch (editors/patch.c, from toybox's).  Every expectation is
busybox's own output, from a busybox built from its source, run as an
ordinary user.  A `|` marks the end of each line written to standard output;
`after:` is what a command run after shows.

## the fixtures

### the files, which busybox made, and a run of patch in a fresh directory

`a.txt`, `m.txt` and `n.txt` are the files the diffs find, `a.new` `a.txt` as
`a.diff` leaves it; the diffs are busybox's diff -u, some of them edited:
`fail.diff` and `fail2.diff` have a context line changed in their first and
second hunks, `epoch.diff` names its old file with the epoch's date,
`deep.diff` names its files three parts deep.  Each run is in
`/tmp/x-cu-patch/w`, made afresh from them: PRE runs before patch, with
standard input the file IN (`-` for none), and POST after it, both through
the shell.

```cu
(do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "rm -rf /tmp/x-cu-patch && mkdir -p /tmp/x-cu-patch/w")) (def pa-f (fn (_ n) (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-patch/" n))) (file-write-all (pa-f "fx.b64") "") (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "cd /tmp/x-cu-patch && base64 -d < fx.b64 > fx.tar")) (def pa-home (Sys getcwd)) (def pa-sh (fn (_ cmd out) (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list "cd /tmp/x-cu-patch/w && { " cmd "; } > " out " 2>&1")))))) (def pa-in (fn (_ name) (if (string=? name "-") "" (let ((fd (file-open-read (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-patch/w/" name))) (buf (%str-make-raw 65536))) (let ((n (File read fd buf 65536))) (do (file-close fd) (pair buf n))))))) (def pa-norm (fn (_ f) (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list "sed -E 's#[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}#TIME#' " f " > " f ".n")))) (file-read-all (string-append f ".n"))))) (def pa-shown (fn (_ mode) (if (string=? mode "x") (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "od -An -v -tx1 /tmp/x-cu-patch/o | tr -d ' \\n' | fold -w 64 > /tmp/x-cu-patch/hex; echo >> /tmp/x-cu-patch/hex")) (file-read-all (pa-f "hex"))) (Str8 replace "\n" "|\n" (pa-norm (pa-f "o")))))) (def pa-case (fn (_ fresh in pre post mode argv) (do (if fresh (pa-sh "cd /tmp/x-cu-patch && rm -rf w && mkdir w && cd w && tar xf ../fx.tar" "/dev/null") ()) (if (string=? pre "@") () (pa-sh pre "/dev/null")) (def pa-stdin (pa-in in)) (Sys chdir "/tmp/x-cu-patch/w") (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8) (def st (let ((oo (file-open-write (pa-f "o"))) (ee (file-open-write (pa-f "e")))) (do (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2) (def rs (cu-run argv pa-stdin)) (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee) rs))) (Sys chdir pa-home) (display (string-concat (list (pa-shown mode) "stderr:\n" (file-read-all (pa-f "e")) "status " (%cu-int->str st) "\n" (if (string=? post "@") "" (do (pa-sh post (pa-f "p")) (string-append "after:\n" (file-read-all (pa-f "p"))))))))))) (display "made"))
```
---
    made

## applying

### a hunk is found by its lines and applied, the file's mode kept; without -p a name is its last part

```cu
(do (pa-case #t "a.diff" "chmod 640 a.txt" "cat a.txt; ls -l a.txt | cut -c1-10" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")) (pa-case #t "-" "@" "cat a.txt" "-" (list "patch" "-i" "a.diff")))
```
---
```output
patching file a.txt|
stderr:
status 0
after:
one
two
THREE
four
five
six
seven
-rw-r-----
patching file a.txt|
stderr:
status 0
after:
one
two
THREE
four
five
six
seven
```

### ORIGFILE stands in for the diff's names, and PATCHFILE for standard input

```cu
(do (pa-case #t "-" "cp a.txt other" "cat other a.txt" "-" (list "patch" "other" "a.diff")) (pa-case #t "a.diff" "cp a.txt other" "cat other" "-" (list "patch" "other")))
```

### -R takes a patch back; -N passes over a hunk already applied; without -N it fails, said as possibly reversed

```cu
(do (pa-case #t "a.diff" "cp a.new a.txt" "cat a.txt" "-" (list "patch" "-R" "-p1")) (pa-case #t "a.diff" "cp a.new a.txt" "cat a.txt" "-" (list "patch" "-N" "-p1")) (pa-case #t "a.diff" "cp a.new a.txt" "cat a.txt; ls | LC_ALL=C sort" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")))
```

### a new file is made, its directories too; a name dated the epoch is none

```cu
(do (pa-case #t "new.diff" "@" "find dir | sort; cat dir/sub/new.txt" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")) (pa-case #t "epoch.diff" "@" "find dir | sort; cat dir/sub/new.txt" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")))
```

### a line marked as having no newline is written without one

```cu
(pa-case #t "nonl.diff" "@" "od -c n.txt | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ *$//'" "-" (list "patch" "-p1"))
```

### a file that is not there; a diff that is not there; a hunk that counts no lines

```cu
(do (pa-case #t "a.diff" "rm a.txt" "ls | LC_ALL=C sort" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")) (pa-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "patch" "-i" "nope")) (pa-case #t "really.diff" "@" "@" "-" (list "patch" "-p1")))
```
